app.tagline: You're 18. The rest is up to you.

hotelSchool.name: Hotel school
hotelSchool.desc: Table service and etiquette: opens the doors of fine-dining restaurants.

permisB.name: Car licence (B)
permisB.desc: Theory and driving: about 3 months and €1,800 at a driving school. Opens ride-hailing driver jobs.

permisA.name: Motorbike licence (A2)
permisA.desc: Track and road training: about 2 months and €1,000. Opens motorbike courier jobs.

permisC.name: Truck licence (C)
permisC.desc: Licence C plus mandatory training (FIMO): about 3 months and €3,000. Requires the B licence.

caces.name: Forklift licence
caces.desc: Forklift operator certificate: opens forklift operator jobs.

barista.name: Barista basics
barista.desc: Coffee, service and customer care: a plus when applying in restaurants.

officeSuite.name: Advanced office skills
officeSuite.desc: Spreadsheets, word processing and organisation: opens administrative assistant jobs.

btsMco.name: Commercial operations management BTS (MCO)
btsMco.desc: Two-year bac+2, in school or work-study: leading a team and running a retail unit. Directly opens the store manager job.

btsMhr.name: Hospitality management BTS (restaurant option)
btsMhr.desc: Two-year bac+2 with internship: running a restaurant unit. Opens all restaurant manager jobs (fast-food, casual and fine-dining).

promotion.title: An offer from your employer
promotion.text: After all this time, {{company}} offers you the job of {{job}}.
promotion.trained: You already have the training: you take the job right away.
promotion.noTraining: No training is needed: you take the job right away.
promotion.training: You first have to complete the "{{training}}" training ({{count}} months). Your employer pays for it and it happens during your work hours; at the end, you become a manager.
promotion.busy: You are already in training: finish it or drop it before accepting.

jobDecision.title: Answers to your applications
jobDecision.textAccepted: Some companies got back to you: you can accept one of the positions or keep your situation.
jobDecision.textRefused: No company followed up on your applications.
jobDecision.nowOrNever: It's now or never: the offers you turn down disappear.

delivery.name: Bike delivery
delivery.desc: Deliveries around town, on hours that suit you.

babysitting.name: Babysitting
babysitting.desc: Looking after children in the evenings and at weekends.

moving.name: Moving help
moving.desc: Carrying boxes and furniture for private customers.

dataEntry.name: Data entry
dataEntry.desc: Copy and sort data from home, for companies.

tutoring.name: Tutoring
tutoring.desc: Help students revise their lessons after school.

pcRepair.name: Computer repair
pcRepair.desc: Fix computers and install software for private customers.

freelanceWeb.name: Web freelancing
freelanceWeb.desc: Build websites and retouch images remotely for clients.

translation.name: Translation and writing
translation.desc: Translate and write texts remotely, at your own pace.

waiter.name: Restaurant extra
waiter.desc: Wait tables during a restaurant's rush hours.

baristaExtra.name: Barista extra
baristaExtra.desc: Make coffee at the counter, backing up the team.

rideshare.name: Rideshare driver
rideshare.desc: Drive passengers in your own car.

forklift.name: Warehouse forklift driver
forklift.desc: Operate a forklift to load and stack pallets.

fitnessCoach.name: Fitness coach
fitnessCoach.desc: Lead workout sessions. Good for health and mood.

eventHost.name: Event host
eventHost.desc: Welcome and entertain the crowd at events.

career.gigsHint: Small jobs, no application needed, paid at the end of each month. One at a time, and they take a toll.
career.refreshIn_one: The selection changes in {{count}} month (every 6 months, 6 listings at most).
career.refreshIn_other: The selection changes in {{count}} months (every 6 months, 6 listings at most).
career.gigLocked: You don't meet the requirements for this gig yet.
career.offersHint: You only see some of the offers, and they disappear over time. The more prestigious the job, the shorter its offer lasts. Spend hours job hunting in the schedule to find new ones.
career.noOffers: No offers right now. Spend hours job hunting to bring new ones up.
career.chanceLabel: Chance of being hired each month
career.lockedNote: You don't meet the requirements to apply yet.
career.slowReview_one: Prestigious position: the answer takes {{count}} month to arrive.
career.slowReview_other: Prestigious position: the answer takes {{count}} months to arrive.
career.applicationsFull: You already have {{max}} applications pending: withdraw one to apply here.
career.quickHint: Short non-diploma courses: they give skills, open certain jobs and raise your odds of being hired, but they weigh on health and mood. One training or study at a time.
career.trainingHint: Long studies lead to a diploma and weigh on health and mood. One training or study at a time.
career.trainingInfo: {{months}} months • {{tuition}}/month • {{hours}} study hours per week reserved
career.lowStudy: You study {{current}} h/wk instead of {{hours}} h: {{risk}}% chance of a warning this month.
career.sponsored: Training paid for by your employer, during your work hours: no fees and no warnings.

promotion.chance: You can ask to become {{job}}: {{pct}}% chance.
promotion.wait_one: You can ask again in {{count}} month.
promotion.wait_other: You can ask again in {{count}} months.

ldds.name: LDDS
ldds.desc: Available any time • tax-free interest • one per person

pel.name: PEL
pel.desc: Guaranteed fixed rate • locked 4 years • interest taxed at 30%

jeune.yearsLeft_one: Closes at your 25th birthday: {{count}} year left
jeune.yearsLeft_other: Closes at your 25th birthday: {{count}} years left

pel.notOpen: Opening: {{min}} minimum, then {{next}} minimum per deposit
pel.penalty: Closing before 4 years: you lose half the interest ({{penalty}})
pel.noPenalty: No penalty: the 4-year lock has passed
pel.noPartial: A PEL has no partial withdrawals: it is closed in full.

create.pathTitle: What do you do after turning 18?

over.title: Game over
over.health: Your health gave out. Your life ends here.
over.debt: Crushed by debt, you lose everything.

comfort.name: A comfortable start
comfort.desc: You start with a small nest egg: enough to change direction without much risk.
perks: A small job of your choice

tight.name: A tough start
tight.desc: Barely anything in your pocket. Every choice will have to count.

estate.rentHint: Send an application: the answer comes at the end of the month. The landlord looks at your income, your job and your savings. Rare homes attract more applicants. Set your housing search hours in the schedule to see new listings.
estate.buyHint: Pick your down payment and loan term: the bank requires a job or rental income, and a monthly payment of at most 35% of your income. You can live in it or buy it to rent it out. Set your housing search hours in the schedule to see new listings.
estate.noListings: No listings right now. Spend hours searching for housing to find new ones.
estate.chance: Chance of being accepted each month

chanceDetail.title: Where your chance comes from
chanceDetail.savings: Savings: 6 months of rent in reserve

estate.applyNote: Application sent: answer at the end of the month.
estate.tooPoor: You can't afford the move-in costs ({{amount}} short).
estate.investNote: The property is put up for rent at the market rent right after purchase, with no move.

leave.label: Your current home
leave.sellNote: Direct sale: {{net}} (value minus 5% fees and the remaining loan).
leave.rentNote: It goes up for rent at the market rent; charges and loan stay on you.
leave.vacantNote: It stays empty; charges and loan stay on you.

own.hint: Properties you don't live in. Rent them out for income (the higher the rent, the longer the wait for a tenant), or sell them (the higher the price, the longer the wait for a buyer). Charges and loan are still due.
own.empty: You own no other property. Buy one as an investment, or keep your home when you move.
own.letChance: Chance of finding a tenant each month
own.sellChance: Chance of finding a buyer each month
own.rentedNote: A tenant lives there: rent comes in every month. Selling makes them leave.
own.sellingNote: For sale: no rent comes in.

reason.job: The bank refuses: you need a job or rental income to borrow.
reason.debt: The bank refuses: the payment exceeds 35% of your income (salary and 70% of rents).
reason.cash: You are {{amount}} short for the down payment, notary fees and moving.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Typical {{total}} h week, repeated all month.
schedule.overHint: Trim your schedule to be able to pass the month.

work.label: Work
work.hint: Your working hours. Working less than your contract risks a warning and unpaid hours.

leisure.label: Leisure
leisure.hint: Happiness: ±1 per hour around 5 h/day • costs money

search.label: Job search
search.hint: 1 h/wk = 1 new job offer per month (0 h: none)

housing.label: Housing search
housing.hint: 1 h/wk = 1 new housing listing per month (0 h: none)

log.startComfort: You're 18. A small nest egg, a place, a car and a job: you start out steady.
log.startTight: You're 18 with barely anything in your pocket. Every choice counts.
log.lowMood: Your low mood is affecting your health.
log.trainingDropped: You drop out of your training: {{training}}.
log.trainingBlamed: Training: warning {{count}}/{{max}} for lack of attendance ({{training}}), this month doesn't count.
log.trainingExpelled: Third warning: you are expelled from your training ({{training}}).
log.catalogRefreshed: The quick jobs, trainings and studies on offer have changed.
log.listingExpired: The listing ({{home}}) is gone, your application falls through.
log.housingFound: Application accepted: you move in ({{home}}), rent €{{rent, number}}/mo.
log.housingNone: Your application ({{home}}) was not selected this month.
log.housingBroke: You can no longer afford the move-in costs ({{home}}): the landlord pulls out.
log.homeBought: You are a homeowner! {{home}} bought for €{{price, number}}.
log.homeSold: Your previous home ({{home}}) is sold: €{{amount, number}} net.
log.homeLetting: Your former home ({{home}}) is up for rent.
log.homeVacant: Your former home ({{home}}) stays empty; charges keep coming.
log.tenantFound: A tenant moves into your property ({{home}}): {{rent, number}} €/month.
log.tenantLeft: The tenant of your property ({{home}}) left: you are looking for a new one.
log.propertySold: Your property ({{home}}) is sold: {{amount, number}} € net.
log.noOffers: No job offers left: you need to search to find new ones.
log.offerExpired: The {{job}} offer is gone, your application falls through.
log.experienceReached: You have {{months}} months of experience in {{field}}: new jobs open up.
log.pelClosedEarly: PEL closed before 4 years: €{{amount, number}} recovered (€{{penalty, number}} of interest lost).
log.pelMatured: Your PEL reaches its term (10 years): €{{amount, number}} paid into your account.
log.jeuneClosed: You turned 25: your Livret Jeune is closed, €{{amount, number}} paid into your account.
log.jobFoundAt: You land a job: {{job}} at {{company}} (€{{salary, number}}/month).
log.jobNone: Your application for {{job}} didn't work out.
log.promotionOffer: Your employer offers you a {{job}} position.
log.promotionGranted: Your employer agrees to your request for a promotion.
log.promotionDenied: Your employer isn't ready to promote you yet.
log.promotionRefused: You turn down the {{job}} position. Your employer might offer it again later.
log.promotionTraining: Your employer enrolls you in training: {{training}}, during your work hours.
log.trainingLost: You lose your job: the training paid for by your employer stops ({{training}}).
log.jobBlamed: Skipped hours noticed ({{job}}): warning {{n}}/{{max}}, {{lost, number}} € withheld from your pay.
log.jobFired: Third warning: you are fired ({{job}}), {{lost, number}} € withheld. This will weigh on your applications for 6 months.

washer.title: Broken washing machine
washer.text: Your washing machine gives up in the middle of a cycle.

party.title: Party at a friend's
party.text: A friend is throwing a big party this weekend.

outcomes.stayed: You rest, but feel a bit of regret.

flu.title: Flu
flu.text: You wake up with a fever and aching muscles.

outcomes.doctor: A few days of rest and it passes.

bill.title: Bill on the ground
bill.text: You find a €20 bill on the sidewalk.

overtime.title: Overtime
overtime.text: Your boss offers you extra hours.

stranger.title: A chance meeting
stranger.text: Someone smiles at you in a café and seems to want to chat.

theft.title: Stolen bike
theft.text: You step outside: your bike is gone.

course.title: Free online course
course.text: You stumble upon a highly rated free online course.

bet.title: Bet with friends
bet.text: A friend offers to bet €100 on a game.

rentRaise.title: Rent increase
rentRaise.text: Your landlord announces a 5% rent increase.

outcomes.accepted: The rent goes up, you'll pay more every month.
outcomes.lost: They keep the increase, and the mood sours.

homeRepairs.title: Home repairs
homeRepairs.text: A leak and a tired boiler: the place needs repairs.

outcomes.postponed: Damp and cold: you feel it in your mood and health.

parents.title: Helping hand from family
parents.text: Your parents send you a small check with a kind note.

charges.title: Utilities adjustment
charges.text: Your landlord sends a letter: a utilities adjustment.
